description: Checked-in copy of the official Maestro flow command vocabulary. It exists so the repository can verify that every command used by MaestroTests/*.yaml is a real, current Maestro command - instead of assuming that a plausible looking command (for example a font-scale or theme-index command) exists. The list is mechanical: it is the set of properties of YamlFluentCommand (the class Maestro's YAML parser maps one flow step to), one property = one command key.

provenance.upstreamCommitHint: main branch, as fetched on the retrieval date
provenance.refreshedHow: Refetch the upstream file and the docs command index, then diff the `val <key>:` property names against `commands` below.

notCommands.setFontScale: Maestro has no font-scale command; set adb shell settings put system font_scale externally (see MaestroTests/large_font_sample.yaml).
notCommands.setTheme: Not a Maestro command; the app theme is changed through the app UI.

valueGrammarNotes.setOrientation: matched case-insensitively and ignoring underscores (maestro.device.DeviceOrientation.getByName), so PORTRAIT / landscapeLeft both work.

bareFormAllowed._note: Commands that may be written without a value ('- back', '- launchApp'). Either they take no parameters at all, or every parameter of the upstream Yaml* model is optional and the bare form is shown in the official docs (launchApp: 'To launch the app under test: - launchApp'). Anything else has to carry an explicit value.
